name: Crosshatch
description: The second clip appears through a crosshatch of lines spreading from a point. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Point the lines spread from (0..1, y down)

params.name: threshold
params.description: How slowly the lines spread from the point

params.name: fade_edge
params.description: Part of the transition faded at each end
